calculation.description: Ranks assets for a five-session relative reversal only when the share of the 15 tradable assets with positive five-session returns is in the lower 20th percentile of its trailing 60-session history. Lower recent relative performers receive higher scores.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history benchmark gates pass with 788 gated dates and all 15 instruments. Subperiod IC/ICIR: 2020-2023 0.064388/2.8078 (344 dates), 2024-2026 0.070585/3.3205 (270 dates), 2027-2029 0.004215/0.2340 (174 dates). Recent drift is material; use conservatively and revalidate promptly.
validation.provenance: Daily cross-sectional Spearman rank IC; only information through date t used for signal and close[t+5]/close[t]-1 is forward return. Universe is exactly 15 tradable benchmark assets.
